id: title:dmarticus:link the task thread in task created prs

review.posthog_relevance: Adds attribution and source URL selection for PostHog AI chat and desktop tasks, distinguishing them from inbox reports and preserving the originating environment in the PR footer and source link.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded capability: it distinguishes the origin of AI-related tasks (web, mobile, desktop) and preserves this attribution in the PR metadata and source URL. This supports PostHog's ability to identify whether a task originated from their own web/mobile/desktop environments versus other contexts, and provides a fallback attribution path. review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on downstream consumption and user behavior, which are not demonstrated in this chunk. No production incident or adoption is inferred. The tier is assigned based on the implementation and checks, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional field clientProvenance to ProductLaunchConfiguration and its use in the footer and source URL selection.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the agent to distinguish whether a task originated from PostHog web, mobile, or desktop, and preserve that attribution in the PR footer and source link.

observations.behavior: Implements readClientProvenance, defaulting to posthog_web when no explicit provenance is recorded and origin_product is posthog_ai.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a fallback attribution path for browser-based AI tasks, supporting the attribution and URL selection downstream.

observations.behavior: Updates the PR footer and source URL selection to distinguish between inbox reports, web/mobile AI chat, and desktop tasks, including a new THREAD_ORIGINS set and conditional URL construction.
